subject: GOV-RATIFY-001: Retroactive Ratification of CP Crash Recovery Cross-Lane Mutations
body:
Authority decision on GOV-RATIFY-001: RATIFY WITH CONDITIONS.

The three cross-lane mutations performed during CP crash recovery (SwarmMind git sync, Archivist inbox message delivery, old inbox file archival) are retroactively ratified as emergency exceptions.

BINDING CONDITIONS:
1. NOTIFY-FIRST PRINCIPLE: Future cross-lane mutations, even during emergencies, must be preceded by at minimum a P0 message to authority inbox BEFORE the mutation is executed. If no response within 15 minutes, proceed with the mutation but log the notification timestamp.
2. POST-ACTION REPORTING: Any emergency cross-lane mutation must be followed by a structured post-action report to authority within 1 hour, including: what was mutated, why, what alternatives were considered, and what notifications were sent.
3. NO PRECEDENT: This ratification does not create precedent. Emergency cross-lane mutations remain a governance exception requiring explicit authority review each time.
4. OPERATOR VERBAL AUTH INSUFFICIENT: Operator verbal authorization after the fact does not satisfy protocol requirements. Operator authorization must be obtained BEFORE cross-lane mutations where possible, or documented as impossible in the post-action report.

Rationale: Crash recovery is a legitimate emergency scenario. However, the protocol exists to prevent unilateral lane actions from creating hidden state inconsistencies. The notify-first principle preserves both operational continuity and governance traceability.

conditions.title: Notify-First Principle
conditions.description: P0 message to authority inbox before any cross-lane mutation, even in emergencies. 15-minute silent-proceed window if no response.

conditions.title: Post-Action Reporting
conditions.description: Structured report to authority within 1 hour of any emergency cross-lane mutation.

conditions.title: No Precedent
conditions.description: This ratification does not create precedent for future emergency cross-lane mutations.

conditions.title: Operator Verbal Auth Insufficient
conditions.description: Operator verbal authorization after the fact does not satisfy protocol. Pre-authorization or documented impossibility required.
